currentWholeGoal.title: DNA, Gen und Chromosom als Informationsträger verknüpfen
currentWholeGoal.titleEn: Relate DNA, genes and chromosomes as information carriers
currentWholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann in einem einfachen Modell DNA als Material der Erbinformation, ein Gen als Abschnitt dieses Materials und ein Chromosom als organisierte Trägerstruktur unterscheiden und miteinander verknüpfen.
currentWholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can use a simple model to distinguish and relate DNA as the material of genetic information, a gene as a section of that material and a chromosome as an organised carrier structure.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: DNA, Gen und Chromosom als Informationsträger verknüpfen
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: DNA, Gen und Chromosom als Informationsträger verknüpfen.
resourceLinks.altText: Ein schematisches Chromosom wird zur DNA-Doppelhelix entfaltet; ein hervorgehobener DNA-Abschnitt ist als Gen markiert. Größen und Abschnittslänge sind vereinfacht.

actualIndividualFindings.scope: Two separate backbone curves / hidden tangents / crossing depth
actualIndividualFindings.actualObservation: A upper~610→lower~850→upper~1090→lower~1330→upper~1570, B opposite. A front~730/back~970/front~1210/back~1450; B inverse. Initial~490 opening into helix independently inspected too. Every visible emergence follows the hidden rising/falling curve; no identity switch or extra genebackbone. Same-colour tubes require tracing geometry, not relying on colour.

Foreground crossings consistently descend right in the textbook projection. Paired rods visibly connect the opposing backbones; reduced/occluded near crossing centres rather than branching into a third strand. Schematic, not chemically resolved atomistic model.

Brace endpoints~x578 and1393; same-strand full phase return~480px. This is about1.6–1.7 full rotations, not two. Long multi-base section and large legible stark verkürzt adequately present gene as an extensive schematic part of DNA; real gene length is not claimed.

One condensed rod, local rectangular zoom wholly inside its drawn body, two dashed edges to coiled chromatin leading into the DNA schematic. No whole replicated X→single molecule implication; organized carrier structure, material and highlighted section remain distinct.

Chromosom, Gen, DNA, stark verkürzt readable at both sizes. Long gold bracket lies outside the backbones; halo behind them, no gene-linked geometry flattening. High contrast, ample spacing, friendly abstract comic wide PNG.
